store_products_exactly_one_target.name: store_products_exactly_one_target
store_products_exactly_one_target.value: ("store_product_mappings"."plan_id" IS NOT NULL AND "store_product_mappings"."topup_product_id" IS NULL) OR ("store_product_mappings"."plan_id" IS NULL AND "store_product_mappings"."topup_product_id" IS NOT NULL)

plan_entitlements_expiry_months_required.name: plan_entitlements_expiry_months_required
plan_entitlements_expiry_months_required.value: "plan_entitlements"."balance_expiry_policy" NOT IN ('duration', 'after_plan_end') OR "plan_entitlements"."balance_expiry_months" IS NOT NULL

coupon_targets_exactly_one_target.name: coupon_targets_exactly_one_target
coupon_targets_exactly_one_target.value: ("coupon_targets"."plan_id" is not null and "coupon_targets"."topup_product_id" is null) or ("coupon_targets"."plan_id" is null and "coupon_targets"."topup_product_id" is not null)

coupons_discount_shape.name: coupons_discount_shape
coupons_discount_shape.value: ("coupons"."discount_type" = 'percent' and "coupons"."percent_basis_points" is not null and "coupons"."amount_off_cents" is null) or ("coupons"."discount_type" = 'amount' and "coupons"."amount_off_cents" is not null and "coupons"."percent_basis_points" is null)

coupons_usage_limits.name: coupons_usage_limits
coupons_usage_limits.value: ("coupons"."max_redemptions" is null or "coupons"."max_redemptions" > 0) and ("coupons"."max_redemptions_per_user" is null or "coupons"."max_redemptions_per_user" > 0) and ("coupons"."minimum_amount_cents" is null or "coupons"."minimum_amount_cents" >= 0)

coupons_redemption_window.name: coupons_redemption_window
coupons_redemption_window.value: "coupons"."starts_at" is null or "coupons"."redeem_by" is null or "coupons"."starts_at" < "coupons"."redeem_by"
